> Please check [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md#scope-of-contributions)
> first — some categories are out of scope by design (anything enabling
> unlicensed copies of Minecraft, telemetry, bundled mod binaries).

## Problem / Motivation

What problem does this solve, or what does it let you do that you cannot do now?

## Proposed Solution

## Alternatives Considered

Including "do it outside the launcher" — why is this the launcher's job?

## Scope Check

- [ ] It does not require telemetry, analytics, or tracking
- [ ] It does not help run Minecraft without a licence
- [ ] It does not weaken hash or manifest-signature verification
- [ ] It does not require bundling mod binaries in this repository
- [ ] Not applicable / unsure — explain below

## Impact

- **Platforms affected:** Windows / Linux / macOS / all
- **Does it change the on-disk format** (profiles, settings, manifest schema)? If so, what happens to existing installs?
- **Does it add a network call or a new dependency?** To where, and why is that acceptable?

## Additional Context

Screenshots, mockups, or how another launcher solves it are all welcome.
